docs.text: Photos for #landscape #scape Friday. Long Point on the north shore of Lake Erie, Ontario, Canada is a sandspit landform that stretches 40km into the lake. These photos are from 2 years ago, on the point, looking south across the lake which was 100% frozen at that time. #lakeerie

Long Point on Lake Erie is a UNESCO World Biosphere Reserve, and it is inaccessible to the public unless you come aboard an authorized boat. And so with our birders curiosity sparked we made a worthwhile trip to the Tip. #birds #birding #Canada #nature #photography (Part 3)

November sky in Point Pelee National Park, Essex County, Ontario. It is a spit of sandy land into Lake Erie. Its tip, which is renewed and removed by storms, is the southernmost point in mainland Canada--there are islands further out. (Hasselblad SWC, 38mm f4.5 Zeiss Biogon, Fuji 400H)

I grew up near Long Point, Ontario, a sand spit that extends 40 km into Lake Erie. It is a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve and home to the one of the largest Carolinian forest tracts in Canada. en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Long_Po...

Today’s walk: Point Pelee National Park, Ontario. This sand spit extends into Lake Erie. This is the southernmost point in (contiguous) Canada. The 42nd parallel passes through those trees to the north, which means this part of Canada is farther south than any part of Wisconsin.
